findings: Changing the idempotency-key format causes retries of attempts created before deployment to use a different key, potentially bypassing prior idempotency protection and creating duplicate checkout charges.
evidence: The key changes from `${request.orderId}:${request.attemptNumber}` to `${request.orderId}|${request.attemptNumber}` with no compatibility, migration, or version-handling logic shown.
checked: Idempotency-key construction and retry compatibility across the format change.
gaps: No evidence of whether outstanding retries can occur across deployments or whether downstream payment processing normalizes or otherwise handles both key formats.
